court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: S.B. Jalna Police Station, Jalna (Crime No.190 of 2019)
case_name: Nitin S/O. Motilal Patte And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Nitin S/o Motilal Patte, Manisha W/o Nitin Patte
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Manisha W/o Sachin Patte

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between the parties. The charge-sheet is before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalna. The parties have settled their dispute out of court and thereupon even the petition was filed under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act by original accused No.1 and respondent No.2 - informant.

legal_principles.principle: The court may exercise its inherent powers to quash a criminal proceeding if the parties have settled their dispute amicably.
legal_principles.held: Since the First Information Report as well as the proceedings were arising out of the matrimonial dispute and the husband and the wife have settled their dispute amicably, case is made out for exercise of inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

legal_principles.principle: A court may pass a decree dissolving a marriage under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act if the parties have settled their dispute amicably.
legal_principles.held: The decree has been passed dissolving their marriage.

outcome.final_order: The First Information Report vide Crime No.190 of 2019 registered with S.B. Jalna Police Station, Jalna for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and the proceedings before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalna, arising out of the said First Information Report, bearing Criminal M.A. No.922 of 2020, stand quashed and set aside as against the applicants.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in domestic violence cases
